blocks.header: The GREEN Lab @ Iramoo participates in grassland research partnerships with Victoria University and other institutions and groups.  Some of the significant research projects that we are part of or have supported include:

blocks.text: Active investigations into seed germination, soil microbiology, fire ecology and the role of cultural burning in grassland regeneration. Projects run in partnership with Moondani Balluk and the Institute for Sustainable and Liveable Cities.

Cultural fire and grassland renewal
Native seed banking and germination
Grassland soil health
Climate resilience of remnant ecosystems
